info.title: Farm
info.description: The farm's own operations. Putting a file beside a page is something many plugins need — a recorder, a drawing, an import — so the farm offers one documented, gated way to do it, with the hardened rules of the anarchive fork of the Assets plugin: the body is streamed outside the served tree, folder and file names are checked, an existing file is never silently replaced, and success is reported only once the file is in place. The Assets plugin's own `/plugin/assets/*` routes are left as they are.

post.summary: Put a file into this site's assets
post.description: The request body is the file itself, sent as-is (not a form) with its own Content-Type. It is stored as `assets/<folder>/<name>`. One file per request.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Folder beneath assets — usually the slug of the page the file belongs to.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file name to store it under.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: Overwrite a file of the same name. Without it an existing name is refused with 409.

200.description: Stored. `src` is site-relative; prefix the site's origin for a link that survives forking.

400.description: Unacceptable folder or name, or no body.

403.description: Not allowed to change this site.

409.description: A file of that name already exists.

get.summary: List the files in one assets folder

200.description: The folder's files with size and modification time.

get.summary: The sites of this farm owned by one login
get.description: Reads each site's status/owner.json and returns the names of the sites whose owner id (or, for a site with no id, owner name) is the one asked about. Read-only; answers for one id at a time, never lists owners. A terminal service uses it to trust only the sites a person owns on a farm (wiki-plugin-terminal trust.json farms[].owner).

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The owner's login id, as status/owner.json records it (e.g. david).

200.description: `owner` as asked, and `sites`, the names sorted.
